snippet.title: Log Away - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Log Away is out now! Step into your own cozy cabin retreat and breathe again.  
Buy during launch week and get the Christmas DLC free to keep forever.

Get Log Away on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3468400/Log_Away/

Build, furnish, and decorate cozy log cabins in nature, then slow down enough to enjoy them. Log Away is a cozy retreat-building game about escaping the noise of everyday life and quietly finding your way back to yourself.

In Log Away, you will:
– Choose from multiple beautiful retreats in nature and craft your own cozy cabins  
– Build, decorate, furnish and rearrange every corner until it feels like home  
– Unlock Keepsakes that whisper memories from a simpler time, based on the Interests you choose
– Fill your album as you unpack each unique item and watch your story unfold with narrated voice overs
– Enjoy calm, pressure-free gameplay: no timers, no grinding, no resource stress. Just you, your retreat, and nature

🎄 CHRISTMAS DLC – FREE TO KEEP FOR LAUNCH-WEEK BUYERS
To celebrate launch, everyone who buys Log Away during launch week gets the Christmas DLC free to keep forever. Add an extra layer of warmth to your retreats with a festive seasonal touch and make your cabins feel like the holidays of your dreams!

If you’re feeling overworked, stressed, or just in need of a quiet place to mentally wander, Log Away is here for you.

Step into your retreat, close the door on the world for a while… and log away.
